settings.label: Settings
settings.lightHint: Simpler graphics: no mist, no river current, no swinging paintings. For weak devices and saving battery.

consent.label: Cookies and analytics
consent.text: Mind if I see what's interesting here? Yandex Metrica and Google Analytics count visits and record sessions, so they load only with your consent. Changed your mind? The cookie icon in the corner.
consent.analyticsHint: Visits, clicks and session replays. Turning it off deletes the cookies and reloads the page.
